item.title: 10-foot-long King Cobra rescued from house in Odisha’s Baripada
item.description: A 10-foot-long king cobra was rescued from the Dukura Range area of Odisha’s Baripada on Wednesday, preventing a potentially dangerous situation in a nearby village. The reptile was found near Bahalda village after it strayed out of the forest and entered a residential house, triggering panic among locals. item.title: Major fire breaks out at private eye testing centre in Odisha's Jharsuguda
item.description: A fire broke out at a private eye testing centre located near Beheramal Chhak in Odisha’s Jharsuguda on Thursday morning, triggering panic in the area. Fire services personnel rushed to the spot and brought the blaze under control. No casualties were reported, as the building was shut at the time of the incident. According to fire officials, the incident occurred at around 7.30 am. Local residents noticed smoke billowing from the three-storey building and immediately alerted the Fire Department.

item.title: Missed exam due to late train: Railways directed to pay Rs 9.10 lakh compensation to aspirant
item.description: After a prolonged legal battle spanning seven years, the District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission in Basti in Uttar Pradesh has directed the Railways to pay Rs 9.10 lakh in compensation to a student who missed her entrance examination due to a delayed train service in May 2018. item.title: Gold prices surge Rs 10,000 in a day, silver hits Rs 4.25 lakh
item.description: Gold and silver prices have witnessed a sharp and unprecedented surge, leaving buyers shocked and concerned across the country including in Odisha. The steep rise in rates has made purchasing precious metals increasingly difficult, with prices jumping dramatically within a short span. Rs 10,000 Hike In One Day According to market data, gold prices surged by nearly Rs 10,000 in a single day. The price of 22-carat gold rose by over Rs 10,000, while 24-carat gold is now trading above Rs 1.78 lakh.
